routes.answer: No free nflverse release has per-player routes run. Nothing was proxied with snaps.

checked.pbp_participation: has a `route` column, but it is ONE label per play -- the route of the targeted receiver on a pass play, blank otherwise -- with no player id attached; it is also only ~38% populated in 2016-2022. `offense_players` lists who was on the field, which is snaps, not routes.
checked.ftn_charting: play-level flags (play action, motion, screen, drop, contested ball ...); no routes.
checked.pfr_advstats (rec / pass / rush): weekly broken tackles, drops and rating when targeted; no routes.
checked.nextgen_stats (receiving): separation, cushion, air yards share and YAC; no routes.
checked.snap_counts: offensive snaps and snap share, not routes.

routes.consequence: Targets per route run (TPRR) and routes-based target share cannot be built from public data. Snap share (candidate 6) is the closest thing available and is tested as itself.

candidates.label: RB target share
candidates.definition: mean over the window of (RB targets / team targets) per game

candidates.label: RB receptions per game
candidates.definition: mean receptions per game over the window

candidates.label: Air-yards share
candidates.definition: mean over the window of nflverse air_yards_share per game

candidates.label: aDOT (air yards per target)
candidates.definition: sum of receiving air yards / sum of targets over the window; deep_volume also needs L3 target share

candidates.label: WOPR change
candidates.definition: mean over the window of nflverse WOPR (1.5 x target share + 0.7 x air-yards share) per game

candidates.label: Snap share change
candidates.definition: mean over the window of offensive snaps / team offensive snaps per game (PFR snap counts, joined by id)

candidates.label: End-zone targets per game
candidates.definition: mean per game of targets with air_yards >= yardline_100

candidates.label: Goal-line carry share
candidates.definition: sum of the RB's carries from inside the 5 / sum of team carries from inside the 5 over the window

candidates.label: QB designed rushes per game
candidates.definition: mean per game of QB carries that are not scrambles (qb_scramble == 0)

candidates.label: High-value touches per game
candidates.definition: mean per game of targets plus carries from inside the 10

candidates.label: Team pass rate over expected, change
candidates.definition: the player's TEAM mean pass_oe (percentage points) over the window, from the team's own games

candidates.label: Targets per game
candidates.definition: mean targets per game over the window
candidates.why: R3 and candidates 1-3 test target SHARE; raw target volume also moves with how much the team throws, which share hides (and candidate 11 tests the throwing rate itself).

candidates.label: Deep targets per game
candidates.definition: mean per game of targets with air_yards >= 20
candidates.why: aDOT (candidate 4) is a rate and says nothing about volume; the COUNT of deep looks is what turns into DK points on a big play, and it is the same pbp pass as end-zone targets.
